title: Null safety and strictNullChecks interview drills

items.question: In production typescript, how would you explain strictNullChecks and the null safety model to a junior engineer debugging a related bug?
items.answer: Start with the mechanism: what the compiler does at strictNullChecks and the null safety model. Give a 5-line example, name one pitfall (validation, async ordering, or null), and one tradeoff versus the shortcut. Mention how you would prove the fix with a test or DevTools.
followUps: What breaks if you skip validation at the boundary?
How does this differ in JavaScript?
items.sixtySeconds: strictNullChecks and the null safety model: mechanism + example + pitfall + comparison — avoid hand-waving.
